Record Class MethodInjectionPoint

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.inject.context.MethodInjectionPoint
Record Components:
factory - the factory owning this injection point
methodName - the method name (for inspection)
parameters - the method parameters, in order
annotationMetadata - annotations present on the method
All Implemented Interfaces:
InjectionPoint

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
